title: compat: support digests parameter in /images/json endpoint
body:
When using the Docker-compat endpoint /images/json with the digests query parameter set to true, the server returned an empty response body with HTTP 200 status. This was caused by an early return that logged the unsupported parameter without writing any HTTP response.

In Docker's API, the digests parameter controls whether RepoDigests is included in the response. Podman already populates RepoDigests for every image in the normal listing path, so the fix is simply to remove the blocking early return and let the request proceed normally. No additional logic is needed since the digest information is already exposed through the RepoDigests field.

Closes #29210
